1#main: The prohibition of overnight delay of the dead and when it is permitted to delay him. In it are 2 seifim. It is forbidden to delay the dead overnight unless they delayed him for his honor — to bring him a coffin and shrouds, or burial niches, or so relatives may come, or to inform towns.
2#main: Whoever hastens to take out his bier — this is praiseworthy; but for his father and mother — this is repugnant unless it was erev Shabbat or erev yom tov, or rains were dripping on his bier.
